description: pizza-op-008 contract: an object_property_assertion claim with predicate=subPropertyOf must NOT return CLAIM_CONSISTENCY_CHECK_FAILED error. Per design D4, the root cause is investigated and fixed. The satisfiability check is NOT applied to object_property_assertion claims (properties have no satisfiability concept). The expected verdict is determined by the Stage 4 exact consistency check.

expectedBehavior.rationale: object_property_assertion claims are excluded from the Stage 4 satisfiability check (D2) because OWL object properties do not have a satisfiability concept

claim.question: Is isIngredientOf a subproperty of isBaseOf?

possibleRootCauses: ClaimAxiomBuilder.buildObjectPropertySubProperty constructs an axiom with incorrect type or direction
CachedExactCheckSession.applyChange does not support SubObjectPropertyOf axiom add/remove lifecycle
HermiT flush issue with SubObjectPropertyOf axiom

passCriteria.primary: Verdict is non-null and executionStatus is COMPLETED (not ERROR)
passCriteria.verdictCorrectness: Verdict matches the gold label per D4 investigation outcome
